width.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for button border width. Use as the baseline button border thickness so inverted and outlined treatments retain consistent geometry across states. Accessibility: keep border + focus styling visually distinct in high-contrast and zoomed contexts.

color.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for button focus ring color. Use for keyboard focus-visible outlines on all button variants. Accessibility: keep a clearly visible focus indicator that is not color-only by combining this token with ring width and offset.

width.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for button focus ring width. Use as the default outline thickness for focus-visible states. Accessibility: 2px or greater is recommended so focus remains visible at different zoom levels and contrast settings.

offset.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for button focus ring offset. Use to separate the focus ring from the button edge so it remains visually distinct from component fills. Accessibility: preserve clear ring separation from neighboring surfaces.

opacity.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for disabled button opacity. Use for non-interactive button states only. Accessibility: pair reduced opacity with disabled semantics (disabled attribute/ARIA) and avoid relying on opacity alone to indicate disabled state.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for primary button default background. Use for the highest-emphasis call-to-action surfaces. Accessibility: pair with the matching on-color token and verify contrast remains WCAG compliant across themes.

hover.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for primary button hover background. Use when the pointer hovers over enabled primary buttons. Accessibility: do not rely on hover-only cues; keyboard focus and active states must be independently visible.

active.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for primary button active background. Use while pressing or otherwise actively engaging primary buttons. Accessibility: active treatment should be perceivable without animation and should not replace focus styling.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for primary button text/icon color. Use for label and icon foreground on primary backgrounds across all interactive states unless a dedicated override is needed. Accessibility: maintain a 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text where possible.

Accretion UI semantic token for primary button default border. Use transparent borders where primary style intent is fill-first. Accessibility: ensure focus rings and boundaries remain clearly visible without border-only affordance.

Accretion UI semantic token for secondary button default background. Use for second-priority actions as an inverted counterpart to primary buttons. Accessibility: preserve clear contrast with secondary foreground and border tokens.

hover.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for secondary button hover background. Use subtle brand-tinted feedback when hovering secondary buttons. Accessibility: provide equivalent focus-visible and active feedback for non-pointer users.

active.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for secondary button active background. Use while pressing secondary buttons to increase state clarity without matching primary visual weight. Accessibility: keep active states distinguishable from hover and default states.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for secondary button text/icon color. Use branded foreground on inverted secondary surfaces for clear hierarchy below primary buttons. Accessibility: ensure text contrast remains legible over tinted hover/active backgrounds.

Accretion UI semantic token for secondary button border color. Use to define shape and hierarchy for inverted secondary buttons. Accessibility: border presence should support discoverability but not replace focus indicators.

Accretion UI semantic token for tertiary button default background. Use for third-priority actions with low visual weight and subtle surface fill. Accessibility: maintain sufficient contrast between foreground text and neutral surfaces.

hover.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for tertiary button hover background. Use for subtle hover feedback on tertiary buttons. Accessibility: do not rely on hover alone; ensure focus-visible styling remains prominent.

active.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for tertiary button active background. Use while pressing tertiary buttons. Accessibility: active state should stay distinguishable under varying display contrast and zoom.

default.$description: Accretion UI semantic token for tertiary button text/icon color. Use for tertiary actions where emphasis should be lower than secondary and primary buttons. Accessibility: verify 4.5:1 text contrast against tertiary background states.

Accretion UI semantic token for tertiary button default border. Keep border transparent for surface-led tertiary treatments unless an outlined style is introduced. Accessibility: ensure focus treatment remains visible without depending on border color.
